problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual budget across 14 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected benefit to the community. The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.181, disruption index is 0.088, allocation limits [0.028, 0.306]
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.145, disruption index is 0.279, allocation limits [0.052, 0.572]
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.187, disruption index is 0.177, allocation limits [0.052, 0.844]
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.132, disruption index is 0.020, allocation limits [0.061, 0.644]
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.102, disruption index is 0.021, allocation limits [0.025, 0.499]
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.096, disruption index is 0.150, allocation limits [0.063, 0.512]
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.168, disruption index is 0.117, allocation limits [0.066, 0.887]
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.089, disruption index is 0.178, allocation limits [0.067, 0.477]
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.061, disruption index is 0.289, allocation limits [0.068, 0.401]
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.096, disruption index is 0.033, allocation limits [0.054, 0.717]
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.021, disruption index is 0.222, allocation limits [0.058, 0.659]
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.110, disruption index is 0.163, allocation limits [0.061, 0.482]
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.152, disruption index is 0.259, allocation limits [0.090, 0.771]
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.148, disruption index is 0.228, allocation limits [0.054, 0.456]
Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget that lies within its specified allocation limits, and the sum of all budget fractions must equal one. To prioritize critical services, the planner requires that the group of high-visibility projects, represented by the subset H = {A, B, C, J, L}, collectively receive at least 0.317 of the total funding. Furthermore, the overall community disruption, measured by a composite disruption score, must not exceed 0.226, and the total projected benefit must be no less than 0.102. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
